recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，箭頭處一顆紅血球內有細小藍色環狀體與紅色染色質點（ring form），代表瘧原蟲感染；單一環狀體無法確定種別，需搭配受感染紅血球變大、Schüffner 點或變形蟲樣滋養體才能判定間日瘧。
features: Single intraerythrocytic ring form (arrow) with thin blue cytoplasmic ring and small chromatin dot
Infected red cell not clearly enlarged at this magnification
No Schüffner stippling, amoeboid trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes seen in this field
Two neutrophils in the upper right corner
Background red cells normocytic with scattered normal platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a single red cell containing a small ring-form parasite (arrow) with a delicate blue cytoplasmic ring and chromatin dot. The infected cell is not distinctly enlarged and no stippling, trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes are visible in this field; red cells and neutrophils are otherwise unremarkable. Findings indicate Plasmodium infection; a single ring form does not permit speciation, so the diagnosis of P. vivax requires additional forms on thin film review, rapid antigen testing or PCR, and parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Rings are typically numerous, delicate, often double-chromatin or multiply infected, with banana-shaped gametocytes and no red cell enlargement.
Small pleomorphic rings, extracellular forms and tetrads, without pigment, schizonts or gametocytes.
Lies in a different plane with granular texture and no ring cytoplasm or chromatin dot.
